transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess… I’ve just been feeling really low. Most days it feels like I’m stuck at the bottom of some dark hole, and even when I’m around people, I can’t really shake this heavy, hopeless feeling.
Have you noticed that you’re not interested in things anymore — like activities or hobbies you used to enjoy?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to like hiking, painting, going to the makerspace… even figuring out a tough install at work. Now I mostly just stare at the stuff or don’t answer when people call. It just doesn’t feel worth starting.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things, even when it’s not really your fault?

Yeah… I do. I keep thinking I’m just useless now, like because I can’t work the way I used to. And I go over things in my head… apprentices I feel like I let down, bills I haven’t paid. It all just feels like proof I’ve messed everything up.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About… a year and a couple months, I think. Since that fall on the HVAC job messed up my back. Things just kind of started coming apart after that.
Have you noticed that you feel more tired than usual, even after resting, or like you don’t have the energy to do even small tasks?
I don’t know… maybe. I mean, I’m tired a lot, but I don’t really know what counts as more than usual. Some days even small stuff feels like a lot.
Have you found it hard to focus, make decisions, or remember things lately?
Yeah… focusing’s been hard. Stuff I used to just know—paperwork, repair diagrams—it kind of blurs together now. I’ll sit there stuck on something dumb, like which form to open first.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately — like eating a lot less than usual or losing weight without trying?
Yeah… my eating’s been kind of messed up. I’ll go most of the day with just coffee because food doesn’t sit right, then at night I’ll pick at whatever’s around. I don’t really taste it much.
Have you had any thoughts about death or dying, or wished you were dead?

Yeah… I don’t like saying it. But sometimes I think everyone would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. And when the pain and money stuff piles up, I… I catch myself thinking about ending it. It scares me.
Have you had periods of feeling this way that lasted for several months or longer before the fall on your job?
No… not really before the fall. This has been going on since then, about… a year and a couple months now. After I hurt my back on that HVAC job, things just kind of started coming apart.
Before this current period that started after your fall, have you ever had a time when you felt this low for several weeks or more?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had bad days like anybody, but not… not like this for weeks or anything that I remember.
Before this current period that started after your fall, have you ever had a time when you felt this low for several weeks or more?
No… before the fall, not like this. I came in because now, most days, it feels like I’m stuck down in some dark hole. Even around people I know, I still feel heavy… hopeless.
Before this current period that started after your fall, have you ever had another time—separated from this one by a period of feeling better—when you felt this low for several weeks or more?

No… I don’t think there was another time before this. It’s really just now that most days I feel like I’m at the bottom of some dark hole, and I can’t shake that heavy, hopeless feeling… even around people.
Since this started after your fall, have you had any periods where you felt significantly better for at least a couple of months before feeling this way again?
No… not really. It’s been pretty much going on since the fall—about a year and a couple months now. After that back injury at the HVAC job, everything just kind of… kept unraveling.

Before this current period that started after your fall, have you ever had a time when you felt this low for several weeks or more, followed by a period where you felt significantly better for a few months before feeling bad again?
No… I don’t really have anything like that to point to. Not before this. It wasn’t like I had a bad stretch, got better for months, then went back down.

Symptoms have been present for over one year, suggesting a chronic course. This aligns with a diagnosis of moderate or severe depressive episode, and given the duration and severity, persistent depressive disorder (dysthymia) with current episode severity needs to be considered.
